interface.default: existing weighted-lexical-v1 unchanged including current relevance calls
interface.ranking: same weights4/3/2/1; unique query tokens; existing words regex/casefold on serialized fields; weighted set intersection
unchanged: full mandatory resources and budget rules

gates.default: serialized output byte parity for unchanged contracts
gates.development: Hit@5 and MRR@5 not below baseline
gates.heldout: at least1 additional labelled positive Hit@5; no baseline positive hit lost; MRR@5 nondecreasing
gates.delivery: Full indexed_skill required-set byte/hash/revision integrity for retrieved positives when budget permits; explicit budget omissions; no lower complete relevant delivery count than baseline
gates.operational: lexical-absence no-match and incompatible-filter no-match separately pass; out-of-domain diagnostics do not gate
gates.synthetic: all8 frozen token contracts pass, all7 unchanged-contract checks pass

evaluation.code_freeze: candidate commit and runtime source hashes frozen before independent review and heldout release
evaluation.heldout_executor: independent reviewer, not candidate author; one paired CPU retrieval comparison with full required-resource audit
evaluation.negative_results: complete gate miss FAIL; incomplete or identity changed INCONCLUSIVE; preserve outputs and failures
evaluation.no_tuning: No old heldout reuse, no new heldout tuning, no retry/search until pass
evaluation.cost: No performance campaign, model/service calls, installs or corpus changes; record byte costs, speed tradeoff remains unmeasured

limits: Small diagnostic set, no production or agent efficacy claim
